cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(ohmydebug_iperf3 LANGUAGES C)
include(CheckIncludeFile)
include(CheckSymbolExists)
include(CheckStructHasMember)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)

set(archive "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/iperf-3.20.tar.gz")
file(SHA256 "${archive}" archive_hash)
if(NOT archive_hash STREQUAL "3acc572d1ecca4e0b20359c7bf0132ddc80d982efeee20c86f6726a9a6094388")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pinned iperf3 source archive checksum mismatch")
endif()
set(source_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/upstream")
if(NOT EXISTS "${source_root}/iperf-3.20/src/iperf_api.c")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${source_root}")
    file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${archive}" DESTINATION "${source_root}")
endif()
set(source "${source_root}/iperf-3.20/src")
set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_DEFINITIONS -D_GNU_SOURCE)
set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LIBRARIES Threads::Threads m)
foreach(header stdatomic.h stdint.h stdio.h stdlib.h strings.h string.h inttypes.h
               sys/socket.h sys/stat.h sys/types.h unistd.h endian.h sys/endian.h poll.h dlfcn.h linux/tcp.h)
    string(TOUPPER "${header}" variable)
    string(REGEX REPLACE "[/\\.]" "_" variable "${variable}")
    check_include_file("${header}" "HAVE_${variable}")
endforeach()
check_symbol_exists(clock_gettime "time.h" HAVE_CLOCK_GETTIME)
check_symbol_exists(clock_nanosleep "time.h" HAVE_CLOCK_NANOSLEEP)
check_symbol_exists(nanosleep "time.h" HAVE_NANOSLEEP)
check_symbol_exists(daemon "unistd.h" HAVE_DAEMON)
check_symbol_exists(getline "stdio.h" HAVE_GETLINE)
check_symbol_exists(sched_setaffinity "sched.h" HAVE_SCHED_SETAFFINITY)
set(HAVE_CPU_AFFINITY ${HAVE_SCHED_SETAFFINITY})
check_symbol_exists(sendfile "sys/sendfile.h" HAVE_SENDFILE)
check_symbol_exists(SO_BINDTODEVICE "sys/socket.h" HAVE_SO_BINDTODEVICE)
check_symbol_exists(SO_MAX_PACING_RATE "sys/socket.h" HAVE_SO_MAX_PACING_RATE)
check_symbol_exists(MSG_TRUNC "sys/socket.h" HAVE_MSG_TRUNC)
check_symbol_exists(IP_MTU_DISCOVER "netinet/in.h" HAVE_IP_MTU_DISCOVER)
check_symbol_exists(TCP_CONGESTION "netinet/tcp.h" HAVE_TCP_CONGESTION)
check_symbol_exists(TCP_KEEPIDLE "netinet/tcp.h" HAVE_TCP_KEEPALIVE)
check_symbol_exists(TCP_USER_TIMEOUT "netinet/tcp.h" HAVE_TCP_USER_TIMEOUT)
check_struct_has_member("struct tcp_info" tcpi_snd_wnd "linux/tcp.h" HAVE_TCP_INFO_SND_WND)
set(HAVE_DONT_FRAGMENT ${HAVE_IP_MTU_DISCOVER})
set(HAVE_PTHREAD 1)
set(STDC_HEADERS 1)
set(PACKAGE "iperf")
set(PACKAGE_NAME "iperf")
set(PACKAGE_TARNAME "iperf")
set(PACKAGE_VERSION "3.20")
set(PACKAGE_STRING "iperf 3.20")
set(PACKAGE_BUGREPORT "https://github.com/esnet/iperf")
set(PACKAGE_URL "https://software.es.net/iperf/")
set(VERSION "3.20")
configure_file(iperf_config.h.in "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/iperf_config.h")
configure_file("${source}/version.h.in" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/version.h" @ONLY)
set(files main.c cjson.c iperf_api.c iperf_error.c iperf_auth.c iperf_client_api.c
    iperf_locale.c iperf_server_api.c iperf_tcp.c iperf_udp.c iperf_sctp.c iperf_util.c
    iperf_time.c iperf_pthread.c dscp.c net.c tcp_info.c timer.c units.c)
list(TRANSFORM files PREPEND "${source}/")
add_executable(iperf3 ${files})
target_include_directories(iperf3 PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}" "${source}")
target_compile_definitions(iperf3 PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE)
target_compile_features(iperf3 PRIVATE c_std_11)
target_link_libraries(iperf3 PRIVATE Threads::Threads m)
set_target_properties(iperf3 PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
